name: ideation-hub
description: Ideation Hub platform, developer, requirements, and mobile store-distribution plugins. The root ideation-hub entry remains so existing Claude Code installs keep loading.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-platform
plugins.description: Schema, REST API, and Model Context Protocol tools for Ideation Hub.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-developer
plugins.description: System design, implementation, and assessment. Requires ideation-hub-platform.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-requirements
plugins.description: Authoring workflow. Skill name ideation-hub-requirements-agent. Requires ideation-hub-platform.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-mobile-store-distribution
plugins.description: Store distribution for a mobile app on the App Store and Google Play. Skill name ideation-hub-mobile-store-distribution. Standalone. Does not require ideation-hub-platform.

plugins.name: ideation-hub
plugins.description: Compatibility bundle for existing installs. Prefer the platform, developer, and requirements plugins. Do not install this bundle together with those three. The mobile store-distribution plugin does not overlap this bundle.
